description: The server-side pack index. A decoy record names a pack by (pack, version); the Control Plane resolves family, interaction level, and digest here. No API field ever supplies an image reference, command, mount, or capability, so this file is the only place a runtime detail can enter the desired state. The packs themselves are implemented by P2-W5 through P2-W8; nothing here is an image, an adapter, or attacker-facing behaviour.
digest_note: digest is null until P2-W4 defines a manifest and a pack exists to hash. A null digest is recorded and transported as null. Inventing a placeholder digest would claim an artifact identity that nothing has verified, which is the same lie as reporting an unreported decoy as healthy.
